title: 20. Exercises: Ensemble Methods — practice set
summary: 5 short exercise sets: Ensemble Methods — practice set, Random Forest, AdaBoost (Adaptive Boosting), Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM) and more.
objectives: Practise ensemble methods without looking at the lessons
Write each solution as a small script and check edge cases

sections.title: Ensemble Methods
sections.body:
**Ex 1:** Soft vs hard voting comparison  
**Ex 2:** 2-level stacking with diverse base models  
**Ex 3:** Ensemble diversity analysis

sections.title: Random Forest
sections.body:
### **Exercise 1: Basic Random Forest ⭐☆☆☆☆**
Train RF on digits dataset, compare with single decision tree, save model.

### **Exercise 2: Feature Importance Analysis ⭐⭐☆☆☆**
On high-dimensional data (100 features), identify top 20 important features. Retrain with only those.

### **Exercise 3: OOB vs Cross-Validation ⭐⭐⭐☆☆**
Compare OOB score with 5-fold CV. Is OOB a good substitute? When would you use each?

### **Exercise 4: Production Deployment ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆**
Build customer churn predictor: handle imbalanced data, explain predictions, feature importance dashboard.

### **Exercise 5: RF vs Boosting Comparison ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
Compare Random Forest, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting on same dataset. Analyze: accuracy, training time, interpretability.
